```
['create a WandBLogger instance with a WandBLoggerConfig to initialize a W&B run for experiment tracking', 'log a dictionary of metrics to the active W&B run using the logger log method', 'add a prefix to each metric key and log the prefixed metrics to W&B', 'use the module-level stopwatch context manager to time and print the runtime of a code block', "save a Python object as a cloudpickle file to the logger's output directory"]
```
